verdict.rationale: DBOS is a durable-execution library with documented agent integrations, so consuming tools from MCP servers is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The pack only documents DBOS's own MCP server, which exposes DBOS workflow-management tools to other agents. That is the server role and cannot be credited to this client-side story. Wrapping OpenAI Agents SDK runs is a framework integration, not evidence that DBOS can plug in external MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
